product.ta-walkstation-system-sx20.summa: The System SX20 was the larger 20 MHz portable with a detachable keyboard.
product.ta-walkstation-system-sx20.histo: Olivetti and Triumph-Adler presented it in 1991 as Laptop S20 and Walkstation System SX20. It shared its form factor with the System 386/33.
product.ta-walkstation-system-sx20.techn: The keyboard could be detached for use away from the screen. The report describes a PS/2-compatible keyboard, a replaceable display and 16 KiB of cache.
BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
The model-specific firmware and a boot disk remain to be preserved for verification.
